name: Tour Core

repository.note: The canonical public Tour Core repository. An address from the operator's message or TOURCORE_REPO_URL is only a fallback; if it differs from this one, Grok asks the operator, and npm run bootstrap:grok refuses a clone whose origin differs. Never a private repository.

integrations.name: Tour Core
integrations.url: hostedTourCoreUrl/mcp when that setting is set; otherwise the open-source PUBLIC_BASE_URL/mcp
integrations.auth: OAuth 2.1 discovered from the Tour Core service. The owner approves in the browser. Grok cannot approve itself.

integrations.name: Google Drive
integrations.auth: Each installer connects their own Google account. Grok's built-in Drive connector is for browsing. Tour Core's own Google approval lets it save records when Grok is not in the chat.

ships: the Tour Core Operator Updates routine definition
integration references for the Tour Core tools
neverShips: a Tour Core Drive folder id
marketplace.activation: A new user connects to the hosted Tour Core service named by hostedTourCoreUrl, approves the connection, and authorizes tour updates once. They do not create a Railway project. The open-source path remains for operators who run their own copy.

neverIncluded: Grok Routine webhook address or key
Tour Core connector token or OAuth tokens
Google OAuth access or refresh tokens
a Google account or Tour Core Drive folder id from another installation
visitor names, phone numbers or other PII
